avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may reduce lenalidomide levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative mood support if needed

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin E (>400 IU daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate anticoagulant effects and increase bleeding risk, particularly important given lenalidomide's thrombotic potential
avoid_supplements.action: Limit to ≤400 IU daily or avoid; inform prescriber of supplementation

avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Antiplatelet effects may compound lenalidomide-associated thromboembolism risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use with caution; monitor for signs of bleeding

caution_supplements.name: Grapeseed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: May inhibit CYP3A4 and potentially increase lenalidomide exposure
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased side effects; inform prescriber of use

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin (standard doses)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild CYP3A4 inhibitory effects at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Use standard culinary amounts; avoid megadoses without provider approval

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases lenalidomide plasma concentrations and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Complete avoidance recommended; switch to alternative citrus fruits

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May alter lenalidomide absorption kinetics; optimal absorption on empty stomach
caution_foods.action: Take lenalidomide consistently with or without food; maintain consistent timing

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous vegetables (high intake)
caution_foods.mechanism: Mild CYP1A2 induction potential at very high consumption levels
caution_foods.action: Normal dietary intake is safe; avoid extreme supplemental amounts

monitoring_notes: Lenalidomide carries significant risk for venous thromboembolism (VTE) and peripheral neuropathy; monitor closely for bleeding, neurological symptoms, and signs of clot formation. Drug interactions are primarily CYP3A4-mediated; avoid strong inducers/inhibitors and grapefruit. Dose adjustments may be needed based on renal function (drug is renally cleared).
